Implement a complete TypeScript module exporting classes `Material`, `Container`, and `AssetRegistry`, plus `updateContainerValue(container: Container, first: Material, second: Material): number`. `Material` has `id`, `label`, and mutable `unitValue`. `Container` has `id`, `label`, `material0`, `material1`, mutable `quantity0`, mutable `quantity1`, and mutable `totalValue`. All numeric values must be finite and non-negative or the relevant constructor/function must throw `RangeError`. IDs and labels must be non-empty after trimming or constructors must throw `TypeError`; store their trimmed forms. `AssetRegistry.getMaterial(id, label, unitValue)` and `getContainer(id, label, material0, material1)` must return the previously created canonical instance when the trimmed ID already exists, ignoring later metadata, or create and retain a new instance otherwise. `updateContainerValue` must require the supplied material IDs to match the container slots in order, throw `TypeError` on mismatch, calculate `quantity0 * first.unitValue + quantity1 * second.unitValue`, assign it to `totalValue`, and return it. Registry instances must not share state.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
